top_signals.title: Democrats, voting-rights groups challenge Trump's bid to block Alaska Senate certification
top_signals.summary: Lawsuits filed by candidate Mary Peltola and a voters' rights group challenge Trump's preemptive efforts to block a Democratic Senate victory in Alaska.
